invariants.rationale: The x parameter is used in arithmetic later in the method, so it is expected to be a finite float.
The y parameter is also used in arithmetic; ensuring it is finite is important for correctness.
Sliders often use non-negative coordinates for position; x is likely non-negative in most UI contexts.
Similarly, y as a UI coordinate is often non-negative.
There is no requirement that x and y are equal; this expresses that in typical use they may differ.
